messages:
samir_support: FYI customer reported intermittent 500s and consistent 403 during token refresh. Need minimal repros and request IDs.

maria_gomez: attaching the latest example from their logs — masked token + request id present. They say it started after a billing change.

maria_gomez: log snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T14:02:10Z ERROR api.request id=01G7X2A9Z3 user=acct-123 status=403 msg=\"Unauthorized\" x-request-id=01G7X2A9Z3
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z WARN api.request id=01G7X2A4Z7 user=acct-123 status=500 msg=\"internal server error\" x-request-id=01G7X2A4Z7
```

samir_support: great — can you also paste the exact curl the customer used (headers) and a minimal python/js/go snippet that replicates auth header usage? customer said they used axios and our Python SDK.

maria_gomez: their curl (sanitized):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"hello"}'
```

jin_park: quick reproducer suggestions — try three minimal variants: plain curl, Python requests using raw header, and Go net/http. Include ?stream= false to simplify. Also capture X-Request-Id header on response.

jin_park: minimal curl to capture headers:
```
curl -i -s -o /dev/stdout -w '\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\n' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"hi"}'
```

jin_park: python (requests) minimal:
```
import os, requests
T=os.getenv('RW_TOKEN')
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', json={'model':'rw-instruct-3b','input':'hi'}, headers={'Authorization':f'Bearer {T}'})
print(resp.status_code, resp.headers.get('x-request-id'), resp.text[:500])
```

jin_park: node (axios) minimal:
```
const axios = require('axios')
(async()=>{
  const r = await axios.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', {model:'rw-instruct-3b', input:'hi'}, {headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${process.env.RW_TOKEN}`}})
  console.log(r.status, r.headers['x-request-id'], r.data)
})()
```

jin_park: go minimal:
```
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main(){
  token := os.Getenv("RW_TOKEN")
  body := bytes.NewBufferString(`{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"hi"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST","https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate", body)
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  r,_ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  fmt.Println(r.StatusCode, r.Header.Get("X-Request-Id"))
}
```

maria_gomez: I'll ask the customer to run these and upload the stdout + request ids. Also they'll send a support debug bundle (curl -v + SDK logs).

samir_support: checklist for debug bundle to request from customer:
- exact curl they ran (copy-paste),
- SDK version (pip list / npm list),
- environment (region, if using proxy),
- any intermediate gateway logs (Cloudflare / company proxy),
- x-request-id values for failing requests,
- timestamps in UTC,
- tracer spans if available,
- last 10 lines of SDK logs with debug enabled.

samir_support: if they suspect billing, ask them to confirm account id and invoice change timestamp so we can cross-check billing events vs request timestamps.

devex_bot: Deploy bot: Noted — if we see repeated 500 series from a single backend shard, escalate to eng-runtime with `priority:high`. Use label `support:repro-bundle`.

jin_park: one more thing — sometimes 403s come from stale key cached on our edge. Have them attempt a direct request to the control-plane token introspect endpoint (if they can) or rotate the key and retry. If rotation fixes it, likely a sync problem.

maria_gomez: customer will rotate token and run the python/axios reproducer. ETA 2h. I'll upload results here and include request ids.

samir_support: thanks — if they get 500 + request-id pair, file in incidents with that id and ping eng-runtime. I'll triage when we have the bundle. :thumbsup:
